name: A fake hospital
source:
Elena was just looking for a way to make ends meet. With a medical degree under her belt and an empty bank account, accepting that job as a doctor seemed like the logical solution to all her problems.

However, after walking through the doors of her new job, reality shatters. This is not a hospital for humans. Elena has just entered a world where mythological creatures are the patients, and the rules of medicine she learned no longer apply. To survive her shift, Elena must master treatments made for creatures that defy all logic.

Will Elena survive her first shift in a place where the impossible is everyday life?

[From [url=https://galletadev.itch.io/a-fake-hospital]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃琳娜只是在寻找一种维持收支平衡的方法。凭借医学学位和空的银行账户，接受医生的工作似乎是解决她所有问题的合乎逻辑的解决方案。

然而，在踏入新工作之门后，现实却破碎了。这不是人类的医院。艾琳娜刚刚进入一个以神话生物为病人的世界，她学到的医学规则不再适用。为了在轮班中生存下来，埃琳娜必须掌握针对那些违背逻辑的生物的治疗方法。

艾琳娜能在这个日常生活不可能的地方度过她的第一个轮班吗？

[来自[url=https://galletadev.itch.io/a-fake-hospital]itch.io[/url]]
